conversation.text: How much is the maintenance plan?

According to the Comfort Club overview (membership/comfort_club_overview.md, effective 2026-01-01), the Comfort Club Standard plan is $189 per year per system, or $16.99 per month, and each additional system at the same address is $99 per year.
Comfort Club Plus is $269 per year per system.
Monthly plans require a 12-month minimum commitment.

Comfort Club members get two seasonal tune-ups a year (one cooling, one heating), priority scheduling, the $89 diagnostic fee waived on service calls, 15% off all repairs, no after-hours dispatch fee on emergency calls, and annual reminder and filter-change notifications.

Plus members also get an annual water heater flush and inspection, an annual whole-home plumbing inspection, 15% off plumbing repairs, and $500 off any full system replacement, which Standard members also receive.
I thought it was $149?

The $149 you may be thinking of is the after-hours emergency dispatch fee, which is $149 for non-members and waived for Comfort Club members (pricing/2026_fee_schedule.pdf and pricing/repair_price_book_2026.csv).
The membership prices in the 2026 fee schedule (pricing/2026_fee_schedule.pdf, effective 2026-01-01) are $189 per year for Comfort Club and $269 per year for Comfort Club Plus, both for one system.
Comfort Club is also $16.99 per month, and Comfort Club Plus is not offered monthly.
I don't have any $149 membership price in the documents.
Hm. Okay.
No problem.

To recap what the Comfort Club overview (membership/comfort_club_overview.md, effective 2026-01-01) says: Comfort Club Standard is $189 per year per system or $16.99 per month, and Comfort Club Plus is $269 per year per system.
Standard members can upgrade to Plus at any time, and the $80 difference is prorated for the months remaining in the current term.
No, that's it. Thanks.
Thanks for contacting Meridian Home Comfort. Have a great day.

conversation.text: I need to file a warranty claim. The unit you installed last year stopped working.
To file a warranty claim, call to schedule a warranty diagnostic.
If the failure is covered, there is no diagnostic fee, but if the technician determines it is not covered, the standard $89 diagnostic fee applies (Warranty Policy, Filing a claim).
Since the unit was installed last year, it is within the 2-year labor warranty that Meridian provides on all full system installations.
Comfort Club members at the time of installation receive an extended 5-year labor warranty instead (Warranty Policy, New system installation warranty).
Manufacturer parts warranties are separate and vary by brand.
Meridian registers every installed unit with the manufacturer within 30 days of install, and registration is required for the full parts warranty term.
Manufacturer warranties cover the part only, and labor to replace a warranted part is billable after the Meridian labor warranty expires (Warranty Policy, Manufacturer parts warranty).
